title: Supply Chain Engineer
description:
Designation: - Supply Chain Engineer/Executive Department: - SCM/Logistics Location: - Prithla, Palwal (Haryana) 
 Roles & Responsibilities Supply Chain Engineer 
 Planning and monitoring material requirements as per production schedules and customer demand. Coordinating with suppliers for timely availability of raw materials, bought-out components and production consumables. Monitoring inventory levels, stock, reorder points and material consumption. Coordinating with PPC and Production teams to avoid material shortages and production line stoppages. Following up on purchase orders, pending materials, supplier commitments and delivery schedules. Managing inward material coordination, GRN, stock reconciliation and material traceability. Monitoring WIP, finished goods inventory and customer dispatch schedules. Coordinating with Stores, Purchase, Quality, Production and Logistics departments for smooth material flow. Preparing material shortage reports, inventory reports, supplier tracking reports and daily MIS. Identifying opportunities for inventory optimization, procurement cost reduction and logistics improvement. Using MS Excel and MS Word. Ensuring timely dispatch of finished automotive components as per customer requirements.

Key Skills: Supply chain management,Inventory management,Materials,Management,Logistics,Supply chain,Procurement,Material planning
